CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_report_request()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin if tg_op='DELETE' and current_user in('postgres','supabase_admin') and current_setting('home.retention_maintenance',true)='on' then return old;end if;
 if tg_op='DELETE' or (to_jsonb(new)-'comparison_id') is distinct from (to_jsonb(old)-'comparison_id') or old.comparison_id is not null then raise exception 'REPORT_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE';end if;return new;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_parallel_protocol(b jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
 select coalesce(case when b?'current_delivery' then
 b->>'production_enabled'='true' and b#>>'{current_delivery,version}'='jev-short-sol-compact-v2'
 and b#>>'{current_delivery,source_run_id}'=b#>>'{reference,historical_run_id}' and b#>>'{current_delivery,generation_id}'=b#>>'{reference,generation_id}'
 and b#>>'{frozen_report,ai_status}'='source_frozen'
 and exists(select 1 from public.report_generation_requests q where q.id=(b#>>'{current_delivery,request_id}')::uuid and q.source_run_id=(b#>>'{current_delivery,source_run_id}')::uuid and q.engine='jev_sol_v2' and q.organization_id=(b->>'organization_id')::uuid and q.establishment_id=(b->>'establishment_id')::uuid and q.authority_user_id=(b->>'authority_user_id')::uuid and q.language=b->>'language')
 and (exists(select 1 from public.analysis_parallel_launch_preparations sealed where sealed.current_source_run_id=(b#>>'{current_delivery,source_run_id}')::uuid and sealed.authority_user_id=(b->>'authority_user_id')::uuid and sealed.organization_id=(b->>'organization_id')::uuid and sealed.body=b) or public.check_parallel_protocol_comparison(jsonb_set(b,'{production_enabled}','false')))
 else public.check_parallel_protocol_comparison(b) end,false);
$function$
